requirements.subject: ent:deactivate-operation
requirements.canonical: The `deactivate` operation IS used to deactivate or suspend defaults, i.e. previously activated altsteps.
requirements.original: The deactivate operation is used to deactivate or suspend defaults, i.e. previously activated altsteps.

requirements.subject: ent:deactivate-operation
requirements.canonical: The `deactivate` operation has the syntax `deactivate [ ( ObjectReference [, Expression] ) ]`.

requirements.subject: ent:deactivate-operation
requirements.condition: the optional Expression evaluates to false
requirements.canonical: If the optional Expression evaluates to `false`, a `deactivate` operation removes the referenced default from the list of defaults.
requirements.original: A deactivate operation will remove the referenced default from the list of defaults if the optional Expression evaluates to false, otherwise it marks the referenced default in the list of defaults as suspended.

requirements.subject: ent:deactivate-operation
requirements.condition: the optional Expression evaluates to true
requirements.canonical: If the optional Expression evaluates to `true`, a `deactivate` operation marks the referenced default in the list of defaults as suspended.
requirements.original: A deactivate operation will remove the referenced default from the list of defaults if the optional Expression evaluates to false, otherwise it marks the referenced default in the list of defaults as suspended.

requirements.subject: ent:default
requirements.canonical: A suspended default CAN be re-activated by an `activate` operation.
requirements.original: NOTE: A suspended default can be re-activated by an activate operation.

requirements.subject: ent:deactivate-operation
requirements.canonical: The effect of a `deactivate` operation IS local to the test component in which it is called.
requirements.original: The effect of a deactivate operation is local to the test component in which it is called.

requirements.subject: ent:test-component
requirements.canonical: A test component CANNOT deactivate or suspend a default in another test component.
requirements.original: This means, a test component cannot deactivate or suspend a default in another test component.

requirements.subject: ent:deactivate-operation
requirements.condition: the deactivate operation has no parameter
requirements.canonical: A `deactivate` operation without parameters deactivates all defaults of the test component.
requirements.original: A deactivate operation without parameter deactivates all defaults of a test component.

requirements.subject: ent:deactivate-operation
requirements.canonical: A `deactivate` operation called with the special value `null` as its ObjectReference has no effect.
requirements.original: Calling a deactivate operation with the special value null as its ObjectReference has no effect.

requirements.subject: ent:deactivate-operation
requirements.canonical: A `deactivate` operation called with an undefined default reference, e.g. a reference to an already deactivated default or an uninitialized default reference variable, SHALL cause a runtime error.
requirements.original: Calling a deactivate operation with an undefined default reference, e.g. an old reference to a default that has already been deactivated or an uninitialized default reference variable, shall cause a runtime error.

requirements.subject: ent:object-reference
requirements.canonical: The ObjectReference of a `deactivate` operation SHALL be of `default` type.
requirements.original: a) The ObjectReference shall be of default type.

requirements.subject: ent:expression
requirements.canonical: The optional Expression of a `deactivate` operation SHALL be of `boolean` type.
requirements.original: b) The optional Expression shall be of boolean type and shall not resolve to a template.

requirements.subject: ent:expression
requirements.canonical: The optional Expression of a `deactivate` operation SHALL NOT resolve to a template.
requirements.original: b) The optional Expression shall be of boolean type and shall not resolve to a template.

requirements.subject: ent:expression
requirements.canonical: The default value of the optional Expression of a `deactivate` operation IS `false`.

requirements.subject: ent:expression
requirements.canonical: The optional Expression of a `deactivate` operation SHALL evaluate to an initialized value.
requirements.original: c) The optional Expression shall evaluate to a value, which is initialized.
